articles.title: Europe's New Missile Shield: 10 Nations Pool Ukraine's Battle-Hardened Expertise
articles.summary: Ten European nations, led by Ukraine, announced a coalition to build an integrated ballistic missile defense system. They cite Ukraine's four-year experience fending off Russian strikes as crucial to protecting the continent from growing threats.

articles.title: Gus the T. rex Hits the Auction Block: Will a Museum or Billionaire Snag the $30 Million Skeleton?
articles.summary: A 38-foot T. rex skeleton named Gus is being auctioned at Sotheby’s in New York, with bids starting at $19 million. Discovered in South Dakota in 2021, it’s one of the most complete specimens ever found. The sale raises debate over private ownership of fossils.

articles.title: U.S. Tightens Grip on Cuba: Tourism Ministry and Key Firms Hit with Fresh Sanctions
articles.summary: On July 13, the U.S. sanctioned Cuba's tourism ministry and two state-owned giants, GEMAR and GECOMEX, giving businesses until August 12 to cut ties. Over 10 million Cubans lost power last Friday amid a crippling fuel blockade.
